description: This PHP file is a class definition for an OpenCart admin controller managing the 'basic' theme extension. It provides methods to display and save theme settings, handle permissions, and generate parts of the admin interface.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: Controller class for managing the basic theme extension in the admin area, including rendering the settings page and handling save operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the theme settings page, including breadcrumbs, current status, and common page elements.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving theme settings after permission validation, returning success or error in JSON format.
